weak__2_heappush__L1.label: strict
weak__2_heappush__L1.dropped: prop_multiset (result is a permutation of item :: heap)
weak__2_heappush__L1.why: Only correctness_thm's Post stated the permutation property; heappush_invariant_thm states only the heap invariant and heappush_equiv_thm only relates uninterpreted implementations.

weak__2_heappush__L2.label: strict
weak__2_heappush__L2.why: Permutation is dropped as in L1 and the exact size increase is relaxed to a lower bound in the only definition that states it; nothing else fixes the size.

weak__2_heappush__L3.label: strict
weak__2_heappush__L3.dropped: prop_multiset; exact size; heap invariant when item ∈ heap
weak__2_heappush__L3.why: prop_invariant is weakened in both heappush_invariant_thm and Post (escape item ∈ heap.toList), plus the L1/L2 losses; no theorem restates them.

overc__2_heappush__L1.label: strict
overc__2_heappush__L1.dropped: correctness_thm (vacuous via heap.size < 0): prop_size and prop_multiset
overc__2_heappush__L1.restated_by: prop_invariant: heappush_invariant_thm; size and multiset: none
overc__2_heappush__L1.why: The invariant is restated by heappush_invariant_thm, but size and permutation are stated only in Post, now behind an unsatisfiable hypothesis.

overc__2_heappush__L2.label: strict
overc__2_heappush__L2.dropped: all three theorems vacuous (heap.size < 0): invariant, size, multiset, equivalence
overc__2_heappush__L2.why: Every theorem carries the unsatisfiable hypothesis, so the file guarantees nothing.
